description: Back up a running deployment's data into the customer's OWN Impreza S3 bucket. Packs the app's data directory, uploads it in chunks with a per-chunk SHA-256 manifest, and returns immediately with a backup_id — poll impreza_list_backups for the outcome, since a large app takes minutes. Requires an active S3 service on the account; without one this answers NO_STORAGE. One job at a time per app. The bytes land in the customer's bucket, readable with their own S3 credentials and verifiable without us.
name: impreza_backup_app
title: Back up app
